implementation.owner: One controller in ProjectSidebar is passed to desktop/mobile menu copies; feedback is outside each project row and the project list's fetch-busy section.
implementation.acknowledgement: Canonical archive is published before detached handled refresh. Remove target from existing active project caches, update existing include-archived record, do not create absent caches or rewrite conversation data.
implementation.uncertainty: One retained unresolved archive per mounted sidebar. Only explicit full owner-scoped project GET checks it; failed checks stay uncertain. Only a successful active result permits a new explicit confirmed archive.
implementation.admission: Synchronous reservation before confirmation; latest rendered active/non-default/access scope rechecked before PATCH. Owner unmount generation fences late callbacks without cancelling a request already sent.
implementation.access: Denied reads/unknown write responses do not republish private cache data. Unavailable sidebar hides notice; check-specific denial hides private notice identity.
limitations: No atomic server archive precondition or cross-tab lock.
No persistence across full owner unmount, navigation or reload.
Focus/layout/browser continuity remain unverified; synthetic hook scheduling is not real React lifecycle.
